name: lcx-sales-automation-engine
description: LCX Sales Automation Engine — full-stack token listing BD (EU/MiCA + US pre/post CLARITY)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @lcx/web" "npm run dev -w @lcx/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lcx/shared && npm run build -w @lcx/web
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w @lcx/shared && npm run type-check -w @lcx/api && npm run type-check -w @lcx/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lcx/api && npm run test -w @lcx/web
scripts.ci-check: npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run build
